notes_pt: Logic 11: o app agora abre o Logic e mostra como importar a sessão (File > Import > Final Cut Pro XML), em vez do erro "The file couldn't be opened.". Mídia externa: arquivo de 0 bytes (pasta do Dropbox só online) agora avisa para deixar a pasta disponível offline, e AIFF-C de 16, 24 e 32 bits passou a ser lido.
notes_en: Logic 11: the app now opens Logic and shows how to import the session (File > Import > Final Cut Pro XML) instead of the "The file couldn't be opened." error. External media: 0-byte files (online-only Dropbox folder) now ask you to make the folder available offline, and 16, 24 and 32-bit AIFF-C files are now read.
